page.content:

page.overview:
Who is Eurymedon?

While he is listed among the Argonauts, the role that Eurymedon played is not specified in depth. Eurymedon was the son of the wine-god, Dionysos and and his immortal wife, Ariadne.

"Eurymedon, son of Father Liber and Ariadne, daughter of Minos, from Phlius." - Hyginus, Fabulae, 14 Category:Argonauts
